purpose: Deterministic global display transform for physically lit midsummer Japan benchmark frames; never a substitute for correct geometry, PBR, lighting or exposure evidence.

displayTransform.reasonForFixedExposure: hero, oblique and grazing evidence must remain directly comparable under one coherent sun/sky state
forbiddenDefectMaskingEffects: bloom used to hide clipping or geometry
sharpening used to fabricate texture detail

sunlitConcrete: white/off-white facade retains visible roughness and macro variation instead of becoming a featureless clipped patch
sun-facing bevels may approach display white but must retain a coherent rolloff into adjacent surfaces
no color-channel clipping that creates neon or posterized edge colors
shadowRecesses: balcony, stair and sash recesses preserve material separation and construction depth
true black remains black; shadow toe may not turn cavities into flat grey fill
shadow opening must come from sky/ambient/contact-light transport first, with only restrained display toe softening
glassAndMetal: window and railing specular peaks compress smoothly rather than hard-clipping
grazing-angle Fresnel response remains visible after the display transform
no bloom halo is accepted as evidence of physically correct reflection
skyAndFoliage: summer sky remains saturated but not electric blue
foliage greens retain hue separation without crushed dark canopies or fluorescent saturation
no obvious 8-bit posterization or severe banding in the 3840x2160 benchmark frame

criticalFailProtection: claiming render quality without an actual render

verificationRequired: 100% crops showing sunlit concrete highlight retention
100% grazing crop showing glass/metal highlight rolloff
confirm no visible color banding, posterization or hidden clipping
correctiveActionOrderAfterFirstRender: fix physical light intensity / sky fill before changing tonemap
fix material albedo/roughness/specular before changing tonemap
adjust fixed exposure EV only when the whole scene is coherently over/under exposed
adjust shoulder/toe constants only from rendered evidence and keep one setting for all benchmark views
